approval_required_for: Any minimal model/shape graph node or edge addition
Any architecture/design-space constraint addition or modification
Any numeric-policy, compare-tolerance, or parameter-binding constraint modification
Any board DDR/AXI/memory/runtime/deployment constraint or evidence binding modification
Any major template_library/template_metadata binding override outside the already selected template set
Substituting missing numeric_policy or target_board_profile facts with inferred defaults, generic board names, DUT output, or generated expected values
Promotion to next stage while unresolved numeric, board, DDR/AXI, runtime, deployment, tool, or sample-project source facts remain open in initial design graph review artifacts

executable_actions.on_failure: Block promotion of candidate_design_graph_summary and emit a bounded repair/backtrack request for each dangling or unresolved node, edge, and artifact reference; do not treat compact validation_errors as checker evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: The compact candidate graph gives aggregate counts and empty validation_errors but does not enumerate edges or prove that every node/constraint resolves to a supplied artifact. Static and reference checks are required before any peer handoff or promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote or approve model graph expansion. Record missing or ambiguous model/shape facts as bounded findings and request minimal node/edge additions only with explicit model_config or case-adapter evidence and approval.
executable_actions.rationale: The graph names the decoder-block operators but does not show shape, head, sequence, attention-scale, residual, or operator-order facts. A model/shape audit must confirm those facts and preserve the Transformer-block-only DUT scope.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not infer missing precision, quantization, DDR/AXI address map, burst, runtime, or deployment facts. Record each exact missing field as a board_open_risks blocker and route to the toolchain-boundary and SACG-extraction peers; any modification to numeric policy or memory layout requires approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Evidence fields contain detailed numeric-policy and DDR/AXI/runtime/deployment values, but the graph must bind them through registered checkers rather than field-name inference. Missing facts must become open risks, not defaults.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block stage handoff and record exact unsupported template bindings, tool protocol mismatches, missing real-tool evidence, or human/repair boundary contradictions. Major template or design-space changes require approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Template library, tool profiles/protocols, case adapter, and human boundary are named constraints, but readiness requires checker-bound evidence that templates cover the selected design, tools are protocol-compatible, and approval/repair boundaries contain forbidden paths.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep source-material and tool identity as not_run/gap. Specifically re-probe the failed sample_project_index row or rows, the zero-count board/quant/tool file bindings, and current VCS/Vivado stage0 evidence; do not pass silently on the warning.
executable_actions.rationale: prepared_inputs warnings show one or more sample_project_index references failed to read, and source_material_counts shows zero board/quant/tool files despite active board, numeric-policy, and tool nodes. Hash-bound identity and current real-tool stage0 evidence must be re-probed before those facts are trusted.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep next-stage handoff blocked, route each failed invariant back to the responsible specialist with the consumed artifact and checker status, and require a bounded remediation cycle before retrying aggregation.
executable_actions.rationale: After peer static, reference, model/shape, numeric/board, template/tool, and source-identity checks pass, aggregate the checker-bound review evidence into one promotion decision and record open lessons in shared SACG memory.

observations: The candidate graph enumerates 20 nodes, including 8 Transformer-decoder-block operators, and 16 named constraints, but reports only 7 edges; the summary does not list edge endpoints, so connectivity and causal operator order are not yet checker-bound.
validation_errors is empty, but this compact summary is not equivalent to passing sacg_static_check, sacg_reference_check, model_config_check, numeric_policy_check, or boundary checks.

source_material_counts shows board_files=0, quantization_files=0, and tool_files=0 even though target_board, numeric_policy, and tool_profile/protocols are represented as nodes; this may indicate dangling source-material references rather than absence of the artifact classes.

sample_project_refs=7 and sample_project_samples=7 are present, but prepared_inputs warnings state that one or more declared sample projects failed to read; this must be resolved with artifact_hash_check and current real project evidence before backend/board discovery consumes the sample project index.

evidence_fields contain extensive numeric_policy, board DDR/AXI/runtime, and tool fields, including exact VCS/Vivado host and probe fields; these facts still need to be bound through numeric_policy_check, addr_map_check, memory_runtime_plan_check, and tool_protocol_check rather than inferred from field names.

model node list is Transformer-block scoped with operators layer_norm_1, self_attention, residual_add_1, layer_norm_2, mlp_fc, activation, mlp_proj, residual_add_2; model_config_check and task_card_check are required to verify shape, head, sequence, attention, residual, and operator-order facts and to confirm no embedding, final norm, LM head, or sampling work entered DUT scope.

tool entities include vcs, verilator, and vivado; VCS/Vivado have stage0_probe_required fields, so required_real_tool_evidence_check must confirm current tool identity/version/compile-link evidence before treating those tools as available.

node.human_boundary exists and constraint.human.boundary is named; human_boundary_check and repair_boundary_check should verify that approval and forbidden paths prevent silent inference of board or numeric facts.

sacg_memory_truth is empty, so there are no active contamination barriers, open retry requests, or backtrack requests currently blocking this review; blockers must come only from current checker/evidence gaps.

The design_team already has 7 constraint_extraction executable actions; this review should sequence those checks and add source-material/tool identity verification rather than duplicate or bypass them.
proposed_actions: Run sacg_static_check and sacg_reference_check on the full initial graph to enumerate all nodes, edges, dangling references, and constraint-source bindings.
Run model_config_check and task_card_check to bind Transformer-block-only model/shape facts and identify any missing minimal model graph edges; approval is required before adding those edges.

Run numeric_policy_check, addr_map_check, memory_runtime_plan_check, and parameter_binding_static_check to bind numeric, DDR/AXI, memory, runtime, and deployment facts; record missing fields as board_open_risks instead of inferring defaults.
Run template_coverage_check, template_binding_static_check, tool_protocol_check, human_boundary_check, and repair_boundary_check to validate template/tool/human-boundary readiness.

Perform artifact_hash_check and required_real_tool_evidence_check on material_index, sample_project_index, target_board_profile, VCS, and Vivado stage0 evidence; re-probe the failed sample-project rows.
Aggregate only checker-verified review outputs into a promotion decision and update sacg_memory with open risks and lessons; keep promotion blocked until all current-stage checks pass.
risks: Dangling source-material references: board_files=0, quantization_files=0, and tool_files=0 may leave target_board, numeric_policy, and tool constraints disconnected from concrete material_index/sample_project_index artifacts.

Model/shape underconstraint: only 7 edges for 20 nodes risks missing model shape parameters, operator-order edges, attention scale, head/projection binding, or residual/consumer paths while still appearing as named operation nodes.

Numeric policy mismatch: the candidate graph includes w4a8/integer and fallback fields, but without numeric_policy_check and parameter_binding_static_check, code generation may later bind inconsistent dtype/scale/rounding/saturation facts.

Board DDR/AXI/runtime ambiguity: target_board is a single node while memory, runtime, and deployment constraints are separate; addr_map_check and memory_runtime_plan_check must confirm DDR base, AXI widths, protocol, runtime image, and real sample-project references are explicitly bound.
Unresolved sample_project_index warning: downstream backend/app-shell target discovery may guess board or sample-project names if the failed sample-project reference is not re-probed.

Tool evidence gap: VCS and Vivado stage0 probes are required, but the compact summary does not prove real host/version/compile-link evidence exists; later compile-only acceptance could be blocked by an unavailable tool.

Human/repair boundary violation risk: if human_boundary_check or repair_boundary_check does not run, peer agents might infer missing numeric, board, or template facts and silently cross approval boundaries.
Over-promotion risk: empty validation_errors could be mistaken for correctness; promoting this graph before checker evidence would contaminate downstream architecture and implementation stages.

edges: edge.inventory: candidate graph reports num_edges=7 but does not enumerate them

output.summary: The candidate initial design graph declares 20 nodes, 16 constraints, and only 7 edges. The compact summary is not sufficient to prove reference integrity, model/shape binding, numeric/board DDR-AXI binding, template/tool protocol alignment, or human-boundary safety. Run targeted static, reference, numeric/board, tool/template, and source-identity checks before promotion; do not infer missing facts from aggregate counts or empty validation_errors.
